sonnet.problem: Card 13 already asked about verse 16's dough line (first part holy, so the whole batch). Card 14 asks about the root and branches line in the same verse, which makes the same point. A second question on it is a re-ask, and the true statement repeats the verse's wording.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: Paul gives a conditional: "If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch." The question drops the "if" and states it as a flat claim: "Paul says the first part of the dough is holy."
